description: Offline (no API calls) structural + $schema validation of a Power BI report definition on disk. Accepts a .Report folder, a definition.pbir file, or a PBIP root (validates each *.Report). Use before 'report create --definition' or deploy to catch missing files / bad references early. Exits non-zero when invalid.
notes: format is 'PBIR' (enhanced definition/ folder) or 'PBIR-Legacy' (single report.json). dataset_reference is 'byPath' or 'byConnection'. When invalid, 'status' is 'invalid', 'report.valid' is false, and 'errors' lists machine-readable findings ({file, code, message}) with codes like MISSING_PBIR, MISSING_REQUIRED, INVALID_JSON, VERSION_FORMAT_MISMATCH, MISSING_DATASET_REFERENCE. Warnings (non-blocking) include MISSING_SCHEMA and BYPATH_NEEDS_BYCONNECTION (byPath is fine for deploy — which rewrites it — but 'report create' needs byConnection; pass --dataset). Validating a PBIP root returns a 'reports' array + a 'summary' {count, errors, warnings}.
